title: itembank selection spec
description: The one selection request every surface builds -- the CLI, POST /api/start, and a named settings profile all expand to this dict, and recording it on the session and in the evidence log is what makes a sitting reproducible. Every field is optional: an empty spec is a valid request for a default session.

objective.description: The namespaced objective to select from; empty string means no objective filter.

prerequisite.description: A single objective identifier; filters to items that name it in [PREREQ:].

prereq_satisfied.description: When true, narrows to items every one of whose [PREREQ:] objectives has a recorded correct response.

type.description: The item type to select; plain equality against q["type"].

difficulty.description: The difficulty annotation to select. The recall|application|analysis convention is a convention, not a lint-enforced enum; an unmatched value simply selects nothing.

selection_mode.description: The selection composition (diagnostic/practice/remediation/exam) -- distinct from the feedback-policy `mode` in session.schema.json.

count.description: How many items to serve; defaults to 10.

exclude_item_ids.description: Opaque [ID:] values to exclude, never item numbers -- numbers move when a bank is edited.

pair.description: A confusion-set name; serves every item in that set together.

profile.description: A named selection profile from settings; expanded key-by-key under explicit flags.
